failure.title: Docker log scanner treated protocol-induced PostgreSQL messages as crashes
failure.note: The second focused Docker protocol retained eight value-free findings and clean teardown proof after QA-DKR-011 classified exact PostgreSQL initialization, negative-invariant, and intentional stop messages as unexpected runtime failures.
failure.diagnosis: The content scanner was message-aware only for the correlated application dependency warning. It was not service-aware, so normal test-postgres initialization, the two deliberate database-invariant integration failures, and FATAL connection termination caused by explicit QA-DKR-009/010 stops were indistinguishable from unexpected application or database faults.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
